Ibrahim: Argus wants a concise perf validation: sustain 250 qps p50 < 70ms p99 < 300ms, with two failure-mode checks: (A) instance failure during steady state, (B) cold-start recovery under burst. Also want a 30s microburst to 1.5k qps mid-run. They need a 1-page summary + commercial delta for 8xA10G Dedicated vs hybrid commit+burst. Can eng run and own writeup?

Rae: I can run it. Model + tokens? cold vs warm split?

Ibrahim: Model: redwood/open-chat-7b-quant, prompt ~130 tok, gen ~90 tok. Test both warm and cold failover.

Theo: Proposed short runbook:
1) provision 8xA10G in us-west-2, loadgens in us-west-2 and eu-west-1
2) warm for 20m, steady 250 qps for 1h
3) inject 30s burst to 1.5k qps at t+30m
4) simulate instance kill (terminate 1 GPU node) during steady state and measure p50/p99 recovery
5) cold-start test: scale new node from 0 and shift 50% traffic to it; measure time to restore p99 < 500ms

Use our harness snippet to shape bursts:
```
./loadctl --url https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate --qps 1500 --duration 30s --payload argus_template.json
```

perf-bot: Quick expectations: steady 250 qps -> batching helps p50 (~60ms). Burst to 1.5k will hit scheduling limits; expect p99 spikes unless we add 2 extra GPUs or enable aggressive batching config. Instance kill during steady: if cluster has hot-spares, tail will recover < 45s; without spare GPUs expect queued requests and longer tails.

Rae: For pricing delta: rough numbers now — Dedicated 8xA10G commit ~ "$180k/mo" ballpark; hybrid (4x commit + bursts) adds ~25-40% on peak hours. I'll refine after we measure tokens/sec/GPU.

Ibrahim: Security blurb for questionnaire: "Default logs redact request bodies at edge. Audit logs store anonymized request IDs, route and latency metadata. Retention: metrics 30 days, request traces 7 days. Private deployments offer customer-owned KMS and isolated log sinks for full separation."

Theo: Ops checklist: @opsbot please provision argus-usw2-8gpu and argus-euw1-loadgens, add perf dashboard route argus-poc/bench, and tag artifacts with argus-5188881234.

opsbot: clusters created: argus-usw2-8gpu, euw1-loadgen. Model image: redwood/open-chat-7b-quant:v4. Warm scripts staged.

Rae: I'll run a quick smoke tonight then full run Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. Draft 1-pager + spreadsheet by Tue EOD and will drop dashboard link here.

Ibrahim: Great. Please include a short "commercial mapping" section: tokens/sec per GPU -> monthly spend under both commit and hybrid models. Thanks all.
